gui

Class ImagePreviewPopup

  • java.lang.Object
    • gui.ImagePreviewPopup

  • public class ImagePreviewPopup
extends java.lang.Object
    A lightweight, frameless JavaFX popup window that displays dynamic image previews when hovering over media records.

    Previously loaded thumbnails are kept in memory so they can be displayed quickly when viewed again.

    Since:
    7 September 2026
    Version:
    1.2
    Author:
    Trevor Maggs

    • Method Detail

      • clearCache

        public void clearCache()
        Clears all cached thumbnails from memory.

        Call this when the active workspace or target directory changes so that thumbnails from the previous location are no longer retained.

      • dispose

        public void dispose()
        Hides the preview popup, cancels background image loading, clears the thumbnail cache, and shuts down the image loader.

        Call this when the application is shutting down.

      • hide

        public void hide()
        Hides the preview popup and removes the currently displayed image.

        The image remains available in the thumbnail cache for future previews.

      • showPreview

        public void showPreview(ProcessedFileRecord record,
                        double screenX,
                        double screenY)
        Displays an image preview for the specified file record at the given screen coordinates.

        Previously loaded thumbnails are displayed immediately. Otherwise, the image is loaded in the background and displayed when ready.

        Parameters:
        record - the ProcessedFileRecord containing the target path and file type information
        screenX - the horizontal cursor position on screen
        screenY - the vertical cursor position on screen

        private void updateOverlay(ProcessedFileRecord record,

      • showThumbnailPopup

        private void showThumbnailPopup(double screenX,
                                double screenY)
        Displays the thumbnail preview popup and positions it near the specified screen coordinates.

        The popup is positioned to the lower-right of the cursor when space permits. If there is not enough space, it is moved to the opposite side of the cursor.

        Parameters:
        screenX - the horizontal cursor position on screen
        screenY - the vertical cursor position on screen

      • readThumbnail

        private javafx.scene.image.Image readThumbnail(java.nio.file.Path path,
                                               int targetWidth,
                                               int targetHeight)
        Reads an image and creates a thumbnail of the requested size.

        Large images are reduced while being read to avoid loading more image data than necessary.

        Parameters:
        path - the Path to the image file
        targetWidth - the maximum desired thumbnail width in pixels
        targetHeight - the maximum desired thumbnail height in pixels
        Returns:
        a scaled JavaFX Image, or null if the image cannot be read

      • isViewable

        private boolean isViewable(DigitalSignature type)
        Determines whether the file type is supported for image previews.
        Parameters:
        type - the file type to check
        Returns:
        true if the file type can be previewed, false otherwise
